premises: Si and C additions to a high-entropy alloy can form in-situ SiC precipitates during melting
In-situ SiC precipitates can significantly improve mechanical properties (hardness, tensile strength) of a high-entropy alloy matrix
The strengthening from SiC in a high-entropy alloy is achieved through mechanisms like dislocation strengthening, load transfer, and Orowan looping
The caloric phase transition in (MnNiSi)0.62(FeCoGe)0.38 will remain essentially undisturbed by SiC precipitates
